responsibility: This file implements the minimum-cost maximal-flow smoothing algorithm GCC uses to repair inconsistent profile counts on CFGs. It constructs a transformed fixup graph from the function’s basic blocks and edges, computes a maximum flow, repeatedly cancels negative-cost cycles in the residual network to minimize adjustment cost, and then writes corrected basic-block counts, edge counts, and probabilities back to the CFG. Its responsibility is profile-count balancing and completion after imperfect profiling or sampling input, not ordinary branch prediction heuristics.
